hints.en: Say you'd like to buy a coat.
Ask if they have another colour.
Ask if you can try this one on.
Say it's a bit small and ask for a bigger one.
hints.t: 좀 작아요. 더 큰 거 있어요?

hints.en: Ask how much this coat is.
Say your wife is tall and has long hair.
hints.t: 제 아내는 키가 크고 머리가 길어요.

hints.en: Say she's a kind, fun person.
Say Chicago is colder than Seoul.
Say your favourite food is bulgogi.
